title: KernelForge OccupancyReport
description: One committed, machine-readable theoretical-occupancy measurement (ADR 0014). Emitted by apps/occupancy_report_main.cpp; mirrors src/common/occupancy.cuh:OccupancyReport plus the emit()-added grid-utilization fields. Every field is computed by the CUDA Runtime's own occupancy API (cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor / cudaFuncGetAttributes) applied to the actual compiled kernel -- not a hardware-counter (ncu) measurement; see ADR 0014 for why.

registers_per_thread.description: cudaFuncAttributes::numRegs -- a property of the compiled cubin, independent of any particular launch.

static_shared_bytes_per_block.description: cudaFuncAttributes::sharedSizeBytes -- fixed at compile time by this kernel's __shared__ array declarations.

dynamic_shared_bytes_per_block.description: The launch<<<>>> 3rd-argument value this report was queried against.

max_active_blocks_per_sm.description: cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor at this exact block_size / shared-memory footprint.

occupancy_fraction.description: achieved_threads_per_sm / device_max_threads_per_sm. THEORETICAL occupancy ceiling, not an achieved/measured runtime occupancy (that would need ncu's hardware counters -- ADR 0014).

suggested_block_size.description: cudaOccupancyMaxPotentialBlockSize's block-size suggestion for this kernel, queried at 0 dynamic shared bytes (see occupancy.cuh comment) -- for comparison against block_size, not a claim that the repo should switch to it.

problem_m.description: Raw --m CLI value this record's grid_blocks_total was computed from, echoed verbatim so downstream consumers (e.g. analysis/generate_plots.py) can join records to a problem shape by value instead of assuming file/record order. -1 sentinel if not given / not applicable to this family (see occupancy_report_main.cpp).

problem_n.description: Raw --n CLI value this record's grid_blocks_total was computed from (for transpose, the single square dimension; for gemm, the N dimension paired with problem_m). -1 sentinel if not given / not applicable to this family (see occupancy_report_main.cpp).

grid_blocks_total.description: Total blocks the requested problem shape's grid launches (-1 sentinel if not applicable / not requested via --m/--n/--n for this family; see occupancy_report_main.cpp).

theoretical_max_resident_blocks.description: device_sm_count * max_active_blocks_per_sm -- how many blocks of this shape could be co-resident across the WHOLE device at once. 0 when grid_blocks_total <= 0 (not computed).

grid_utilization_fraction.description: min(1, grid_blocks_total / theoretical_max_resident_blocks) -- what fraction of the device's total block-residency capacity this problem shape's grid can occupy in a single wave. 0.0 when grid_blocks_total <= 0 (not computed, not a claim of 0% utilization).
